specific_competences.specific_competence: Demonstrate mastery of basic concepts, theories and principles of Physics
learning_activities: (a) Explain the concept of Physics (Meaning, branches and connection with other disciplines)
(b) Discuss the contribution of Physics to the development of modern society
(c) Explain concepts of physical quantities (fundamental and derived quantities) and their, SI units
(d) Describe concepts of linear motion (speed, velocity, acceleration, distance, and displacement)
(e) Explain the concepts and principles related to force, density, pressure, work, power, energy
(f) Deduce the relationship between density, sinking and floating
(g) Describe the mechanical properties of matter in relation to force and energy
teaching_methods: Brainstorming: Guide students to brainstorm different physical phenomena (natural and man-made) in their environment in relation to Physics Group discussion: Guide students in manageable groups through the use of ICT to come up with the meaning and branches of Physics Field trip: Organise field trips to help students to explore the applications of Physics in real life experience

Brainstorming: Guide students to brainstorm on the contributions of Physics in the development of modern society ICT-based learning: Guide the students through different Online sources and web-based information to explore contributions of Physics in the development of modern society

Brainstorming: Guide students to brainstorm on measurable objects found in their environment Jigsaw: Guide students through Jigsaw method to measure the size of various objects assign the SI Unit of the measured quantities

Circle the sage: Guide students through circle- the-sage to explore the concept of linear motion Questions and answers: Facilitate the students through questions and answers on the real-life applications of linear motion ICT based learning: Guide students through the use of interactive simulations to visualize the concept of linear motion

Brainstorming: Guide students to brainstorm on the concepts and principles related to force, density, pressure work, power and energy ICT based learning: Guide students through the use of interactive simulations to visualize the concepts and principles related to force, density, pressure, work, power, energy Questions and answers: Use questions and answers to guide students explaining the principle related to force, density, pressure, power and energy

Experimentation: Guide the students to perform an experiment to deduce the relationship between density, sinking and floating ICT-based learning: Guide student through the use of different online sources and web-based information to explore principles related to density, sinking and floating

Think-ink pair share: Guide the students through Think ink pair share to explore the mechanical properties of matter in relation to force and energy Group discussion: Organize students in manageable groups to discuss different terms related to mechanical properties of matter Experimentation: Guide the students through experiment to investigate the relationship between various mechanical properties of matter
assessment_criteria: Concept of Physics is clearly explained
Contributions of Physics to the development of modern society are clearly discussed
The concepts of physical quantities are clearly explained
The concepts of linear motion are clearly described
The concepts and principles related to force, density, pressure, work, power and energy are explained clearly
The relationship between density, sinking and floating is correctly deduced
The concepts and principles related to force, density, pressure, power and energy are explained clearly
